text:
claire: quick idea for improving postmortem followups: run 2-week 'close-the-loop' sprintlets that own remediation closures and recurrence analysis. short, timeboxed, with rotating leads. thoughts?

ben: like it. keeps momentum vs endless open actions. what's the cadence/roles?

satya: propose: 2-week sprintlet, lead (rotating SRE), verifier (product SME), shadow owner (backup). each action must have a single-line acceptance criterion and an evidence link.

priya: automation: oncall-bot creates sprintlet board when a postmortem has >3 actions or a recurrence-tag. bot posts weekly standup pings to owners.

oncall-bot: automated: created sprintlet board SS-31299 for incident 3129997777, assigned lead @claire, reminders set Mon/Wed/Fri. link: https://tracker.example/SS-31299

ben: also add a short "recurrence hypothesis" field per action so owners note why it might have reoccurred. helps retro pattern detection.
satya: agree. final check: require evidence (metric/canary) and a rollback plan before closing.

claire: next steps: 1) satya to draft sprintlet doc and rotate schedule, 2) priya to tweak oncall-bot automation, 3) ben to add recurrence tags and simple dashboard row. i'll pilot this sprintlet on current open postmortems.

priya: sounds good. will share bot PR by EOD.

claire: thanks all  if anyone wants to tweak the acceptance criteria template, drop it here or open a tiny PR.
